violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED: the person in charge (PIC) is not a certified food manager (CFM).
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: PIC will need to obtain a CFM certificate within 10 calendar days.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: rice noodle (46f) was stored in 3-door prep cooler (right unit) overnight. Beef broth (44f) and Vietnamese coffee (44-48f) was stored in walk-in cooler overnight.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS prompted PIC to discard the abovementioned food items.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: - OBSERVED: ambient temperature of walk-in cooler was 43f.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: relocated TCS food items and obtain urgent service for the unit within 10 calendar days.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: - OBSERVED: the fluorescent light fixture in the walk-in cooler is missing its light bulbs and protective cover.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. - OBSERVED: the quaternary ammonia test kit was expired.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit within 10 calendar days.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: - OBSERVED: (1) bean sprouts (52f), marinated chicken (49f), and rice noodles (57f) were stored in walk-in cooler overnight; (2) sliced tomato (48-52f) and cut lettuce (55- 56f) were stored in Beverage air 3-door prep cooler (left) for 4.5 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the abovementioned food items.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: grilled chicken (127-129f) and cooked pork (127f) were stored in SERVIT hot box for 30 minutes.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM will discard the abovementioned food items within 3.5 hours.
